title: Run a retrospective
summary: A regular session where the team looks at how it is working and agrees one or two improvements. It is how teams get better over time.

beginner: Hold it at the end of each sprint or every few weeks.
Make it safe: what is said stays in the room, and no blame.
Ask what went well, what did not and what to try.
Group the ideas and vote on the most important.
Agree one or two actions with owners.
Check last time's actions at the start of the next one.
intermediate: Vary the format to keep it fresh.
Agree a small number of actions.
experienced: Look at patterns across several retrospectives.
Use data such as cycle time to inform discussion.
Address team health, not just process.

toolExamples.miro: Use a retrospective template with sticky notes.
toolExamples.confluence: Use the retrospective page template to record actions.
toolExamples.mural: Run anonymous input then group and vote.

definitionOfDone: One or two actions with owners
pitfalls: Same complaints every time with no change
